summary: Empire Petroleum Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $7.5 million of common stock through Roth Capital Partners. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration statement, not a special situation. The company may sell shares at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% agent commission. No deal terms, premium, or special structural features are present. The filing is purely a capital-raising mechanism with no strategic event trigger.
